message.title: Xplora Q2 26: Surpassing the half million mark on subscriptions in Q2, with H1 EBITDA after capex up 50% to NOK 56m
message.body:
Oslo, 19 August 2026 -- Xplora Technologies AS ("Xplora") today published its
results for the second quarter and first half of 2026, demonstrating the
resilience of its business strategy with continued subscription growth, higher
recurring service revenue and improved gross margins, despite a general softer
consumer sentiment.

Total revenue in Q2 26 was NOK 422m, down 9% year-on-year. Service revenue
increased by 10% to NOK 90 million with ARR of NOK 359m. Gross profit ended at
NOK 228m, reflecting a gross margin improvement to 54% from 50% in the second
quarter last year. Operating costs were flat year-on-year, and the reported
EBITDA of NOK 49m compares to NOK 51m in the second quarter last year.

"When consumer demand softens, we place greater emphasis on protecting margins
and operational efficiency while continuing to expand our recurring revenue
base. During the first half year, Xplora has remained focused on delivering on
the three core value drivers we have highlighted in past reporting periods;
gross profit, subscription growth and EBITDA after capex." says CEO Sten
Kirkbak.

For the first half year, total revenue was flat at NOK 798m. Gross profit
reached NOK 433m, up from NOK 422m in the first half 2025, with the gross
margin improving to 54% from 53%. The number of subscriptions reached 502k, an
increase of 108k or 27% compared to the end of the second quarter last year,
and exceeding the halfway mark towards the goal of reaching one million
subscriptions. Reported EBITDA increased to NOK 76m in H1 26 from NOK 69m last
year. EBITDA after capex amounted to NOK 56m for the first half 2026, an
increase of 50% from NOK 38m in the first half last year.

During the quarter the company executed key strategic initiatives to continue
the progress towards the target of 1 million subscriptions. By signing an SPA
for the acquisition of emporia Group, a market leader in senior mobile phones
in the DACH region, Xplora strengthened the foundation for the roll-out of
subscription services in the Senior segment, as well as defining natural
markets for exploring new MVNOs. In addition, the company also launched the
pilot for the retail point-of-sale (POS) system through a Nordic retail
partner in late Q2 26. Although at an early stage, a POS system enables
distribution of Xplora services through retail partners alongside device
sales.

"With a growing portfolio across both the Children & Youth and Senior
segments, an expanding Xplora Connect ecosystem, more than half a million
subscriptions, and a broader international footprint, we are well positioned
to deliver long-term profitable growth. Our focus now is on disciplined
execution to realise the full potential of this platform," says Kirkbak.

---

The company will present the financial results for the first quarter today at
08:00 CET at the offices of SpareBank 1 Markets in Olav Vs gate 5, 0161, Oslo.

Program (all times in CET):
07:00: Q2 2026 report published on NewsWeb and Xplora IR website.
08:00: Live and webcasted presentation of the Q2 2026 results by CEO Sten
Kirkbak,
CFO Knut Stålen, CCO Kjetil Fennefoss, and the Business Unit Directors Tommy
Krznaric (Senior) and Gro Dyrnes (Children & Youth), followed by a Q&A
session.

The presentation will be transmitted via live webcast on the company's website

About Xplora Technologies AS:
Xplora Technologies is a Norway-founded, technology company creating smart
devices, services and communication solutions for children, youth and seniors
that keep families connected, safe, and balanced. The company's purpose is to
build a safer and healthier digital life for all generations. As the pioneer
of the kids' smartwatch category in Europe, Xplora Technologies today serves
the full spectrum of family needs from early childhood to later life, through
its two brands Xplora and Doro. The company positions itself as a family-first
organisation and a trusted advisor for parents and caregivers throughout the
digital journey, delivering the right technology at the right time. Xplora
Technologies is headquartered in Oslo, Norway with operations in leading
European markets and North America. The company is listed on Euronext Growth
under the ticker XPLRA.
